description: Header file defining base classes and implementations for sensor sub-hal interfaces in Android hardware sensors, including version-specific subclasses and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: ISensorsSubHalBase
classes.description: Abstract base class providing common sensor sub-hal interface methods and callback handling.

classes.name: SensorsSubHalBase
classes.description: Template class combining ISensorsSubHalBase with specific sub-hal implementations.

classes.description: Implementation of sensor sub-hal for version 2.0, with version-specific data conversions.

classes.name: SensorsSubHalV2_1
